The '''Czerka utility belt''' was an [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]] developed by the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka corporation]] for use by their own maintenance staff. The many tasks with which this belt assisted quickly made it a popular item throughout the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]].
